entries.label: Cultist
entries.summary: Medium humanoid, any non-good alignment. Armor Class 12, 9 hit points, challenge rating 1/8.

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.text: The cultist has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

entries.label: Darkmantle
entries.summary: Small monstrosity, unaligned. Armor Class 11, 22 hit points, challenge rating 1/2.

traits.name: Darkness Aura
traits.text: A 15-foot radius of magical darkness extends out from the darkmantle, moves with it, and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts as long as the darkmantle maintains concentration, up to 10 minutes (as if concentrating on a spell). Darkvision can't penetrate this darkness, and no natural light can illuminate it. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 10 ft., fly 30 ft.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.text: The darkmantle can't use its blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While the darkmantle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a cave formation such as a stalactite or stalagmite.

entries.label: Death Dog
entries.summary: Medium monstrosity, neutral evil. Armor Class 12, 39 hit points, challenge rating 1.

traits.name: Two-Headed
traits.text: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

entries.label: Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)
entries.summary: Small humanoid, neutral good. Armor Class 15, 16 hit points, challenge rating 1/2.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.text: The gnome has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The gnome's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: nondetection (self only) 1/day each: blindness/deafness, blur, disguise self

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.text: The gnome has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

entries.label: Deer
entries.summary: Medium beast, unaligned. Armor Class 13, 4 hit points, challenge rating 0.

entries.label: Deva
entries.summary: Medium celestial, lawful good. Armor Class 17, 136 hit points, challenge rating 10.

traits.name: Healing Touch
traits.text: The deva touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.text: The deva magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the deva's choice). See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Deva is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Nonmagical attacks
traits.text: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks A fight has no way to ask whether a weapon is magical, so this qualifier is not applied.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 30 ft., fly 90 ft.

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.text: The deva's weapon attacks are magical. When the deva hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The deva's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). The deva can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components: At will: detect evil and good 1/day each: commune, raise dead

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The deva has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.label: Dire Wolf
entries.summary: Large beast, unaligned. Armor Class 14, 37 hit points, challenge rating 1.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.text: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

entries.label: Djinni
entries.summary: Large elemental, chaotic good. Armor Class 17, 161 hit points, challenge rating 11.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 30 ft., fly 90 ft.

traits.name: Elemental Demise
traits.text: If the djinni dies, its body disintegrates into a warm breeze, leaving behind only equipment the djinni was wearing or carrying.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The djinni's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Variant: Genie Powers
traits.text: Genies have a variety of magical capabilities, including spells. A few have even greater powers that allow them to alter their appearance or the nature of reality. Disguises. Some genies can veil themselves in illusion to pass as other similarly shaped creatures. See the SRD for the full text.

entries.label: Doppelganger
entries.summary: Medium monstrosity, neutral. Armor Class 14, 52 hit points, challenge rating 3.

traits.name: Read Thoughts
traits.text: The doppelganger magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 ft. of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 ft. of wood or dirt, 2 ft. of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.text: The doppelganger has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.text: The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.text: If the doppelganger surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage from the attack.

entries.label: Draft Horse
entries.summary: Large beast, unaligned. Armor Class 10, 19 hit points, challenge rating 1/4.

entries.label: Dragon Turtle
entries.summary: Gargantuan dragon, neutral. Armor Class 20, 341 hit points, challenge rating 17.

traits.name: Tail
traits.text: Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the dragon turtle and knocked prone.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.text: The dragon turtle makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. It can make one tail attack in place of its two claw attacks.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 20 ft., swim 40 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon turtle can breathe air and water.

entries.label: Dretch
entries.summary: Small fiend, chaotic evil. Armor Class 11, 18 hit points, challenge rating 1/4.

entries.label: Drider
entries.summary: Large monstrosity, chaotic evil. Armor Class 19, 123 hit points, challenge rating 6.

traits.name: Longsword
traits.text: Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.text: The drider makes three attacks, either with its longsword or its longbow. It can replace one of those attacks with a bite attack.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 30 ft., climb 30 ft.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: The drider has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drider to sleep.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The drider's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13). The drider can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: dancing lights 1/day each: darkness, faerie fire

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the drider has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.text: The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

entries.label: Drow
entries.summary: Medium humanoid, neutral evil. Armor Class 15, 13 hit points, challenge rating 1/4.

traits.text: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The drow's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: dancing lights 1/day each: darkness, faerie fire

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.label: Druid
entries.summary: Medium humanoid, any alignment. Armor Class 11, 27 hit points, challenge rating 2.

spells.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.notes: Conjuration. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

spells.notes: Divination. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: 10 minutes. Components: V, S.

spells.notes: Evocation. Casting time: action. Range: Self. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

spells.notes: Enchantment. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: 24 hours. Components: V, S, M.

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.notes: Transmutation. Casting time: action. Range: Touch. Duration: 1 hour. Components: V, S, M.

traits.name: Quarterstaff
traits.text: Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh or if wielded with two hands.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: The druid is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared: * Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, produce flame, shillelagh * 1st level (4 slots): entangle, longstrider, speak with animals, thunderwave * 2nd level (3 slots): animal messenger, barkskin

entries.label: Dryad
entries.summary: Medium fey, neutral. Armor Class 11, 22 hit points, challenge rating 1.

traits.name: Club
traits.text: Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The dryad's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). The dryad can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: druidcraft 3/day each: entangle, goodberry 1/day each: barkskin, pass without trace, shillelagh

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.text: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Tree Stride
traits.text: Once on her turn, the dryad can use 10 ft. of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 ft. of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the second tree. Both trees must be large or bigger.

entries.label: Duergar
entries.summary: Medium humanoid, lawful evil. Armor Class 16, 26 hit points, challenge rating 1.

traits.name: Enlarge
traits.text: For 1 minute, the duergar magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, the duergar is Large, doubles its damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the duergar lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

traits.name: War Pick
traits.text: Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

traits.name: Javelin
traits.text: Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.text: The duergar magically turns invisible until it attacks, casts a spell, or uses its Enlarge, or until its concentration is broken, up to 1 hour (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the duergar wears or carries is invisible with it.

traits.name: Duergar Resilience
traits.text: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.label: Dust Mephit
entries.summary: Small elemental, neutral evil. Armor Class 12, 17 hit points, challenge rating 1/2.

traits.name: Variant: Summon Mephits
traits.text: The mephit has a 25 percent chance of summoning 1d4 mephits of its kind. A summoned mephit appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner, acts as an ally of its summoner, and can't summon other mephits. It remains for 1 minute, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 30 ft., fly 30 ft.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.text: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of dust. Each creature within 5 ft. of it must then succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw on each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (1/Day)
traits.text: The mephit can innately cast _sleep_, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.

entries.label: Eagle
entries.summary: Small beast, unaligned. Armor Class 12, 3 hit points, challenge rating 0.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 10 ft., fly 60 ft.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.text: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.label: Earth Elemental
entries.summary: Large elemental, neutral. Armor Class 17, 126 hit points, challenge rating 5.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Earth Elemental is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Nonmagical attacks
traits.text: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks A fight has no way to ask whether a weapon is magical, so this qualifier is not applied.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 30 ft., burrow 30 ft.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.text: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

entries.label: Efreeti
entries.summary: Large elemental, lawful evil. Armor Class 17, 200 hit points, challenge rating 11.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.text: The efreeti makes two scimitar attacks or uses its Hurl Flame twice.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 40 ft., fly 60 ft.

traits.name: Elemental Demise
traits.text: If the efreeti dies, its body disintegrates in a flash of fire and puff of smoke, leaving behind only equipment the djinni was wearing or carrying.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The efreeti's innate spell casting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect magic 3/day each: enlarge/reduce, tongues 1/day each: conjure elemental (fire elemental only), gaseous form, invisibility, major image, plane shift, wall of fire

traits.name: Variant: Genie Powers
traits.text: Genies have a variety of magical capabilities, including spells. A few have even greater powers that allow them to alter their appearance or the nature of reality. Disguises. Some genies can veil themselves in illusion to pass as other similarly shaped creatures. See the SRD for the full text.

entries.label: Elephant
entries.summary: Huge beast, unaligned. Armor Class 12, 76 hit points, challenge rating 4.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.text: If the elephant moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the elephant can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

entries.label: Elk
entries.summary: Large beast, unaligned. Armor Class 10, 13 hit points, challenge rating 1/4.

traits.name: Charge
traits.text: If the elk moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

entries.label: Erinyes
entries.summary: Medium fiend, lawful evil. Armor Class 18, 153 hit points, challenge rating 12.

traits.name: Longsword
traits.text: Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) poison damage.

traits.name: Variant: Rope of Entanglement
traits.text: Some erinyes carry a rope of entanglement (detailed in the Dungeon Master's Guide). When such an erinyes uses its Multiattack, the erinyes can use the rope in place of two of the attacks.

traits.name: Nonmagical attacks
traits.text: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons A fight has no way to ask whether a weapon is magical, so this qualifier is not applied.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 30 ft., fly 60 ft.

traits.name: Hellish Weapons
traits.text: The erinyes's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 13 (3d8) poison damage on a hit (included in the attacks).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The erinyes has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.label: Ettercap
entries.summary: Medium monstrosity, neutral evil. Armor Class 13, 44 hit points, challenge rating 2.

traits.name: Web
traits.text: Hit: The creature is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained creature can make a DC 11 Strength check, escaping from the webbing on a success. The effect ends if the webbing is destroyed. The webbing has AC 10, 5 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage and immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 30 ft., climb 30 ft.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.text: While in contact with a web, the ettercap knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.text: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

entries.label: Ettin
entries.summary: Large giant, chaotic evil. Armor Class 12, 85 hit points, challenge rating 4.

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.text: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.text: When one of the ettin's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

entries.label: Fire Elemental
entries.summary: Large elemental, neutral. Armor Class 13, 102 hit points, challenge rating 5.

traits.name: Touch
traits.text: Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Fire Elemental is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Nonmagical attacks
traits.text: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks A fight has no way to ask whether a weapon is magical, so this qualifier is not applied.

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.text: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. In addition, the elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: The elemental sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light in an additional 30 ft..

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.text: For every 5 ft. the elemental moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

entries.label: Fire Giant
entries.summary: Huge giant, lawful evil. Armor Class 18, 162 hit points, challenge rating 9.

entries.label: Flesh Golem
entries.summary: Medium construct, neutral. Armor Class 9, 93 hit points, challenge rating 5.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Flesh Golem is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Nonmagical attacks
traits.text: lightning, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons A fight has no way to ask whether a weapon is magical, so this qualifier is not applied.

traits.name: Aversion of Fire
traits.text: If the golem takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.text: Whenever the golem starts its turn with 40 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.text: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

entries.label: Flying Snake
entries.summary: Tiny beast, unaligned. Armor Class 14, 5 hit points, challenge rating 1/8.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 30 ft., fly 60 ft., swim 30 ft.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.text: The snake doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

entries.label: Flying Sword
entries.summary: Small construct, unaligned. Armor Class 17, 17 hit points, challenge rating 1/4.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 0 ft., fly 50 ft. (hover)

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.text: The sword is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the sword must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While the sword remains motionless and isn't flying, it is indistinguishable from a normal sword.

entries.label: Frost Giant
entries.summary: Huge giant, neutral evil. Armor Class 15, 138 hit points, challenge rating 8.

entries.label: Gargoyle
entries.summary: Medium elemental, chaotic evil. Armor Class 15, 52 hit points, challenge rating 2.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Gargoyle is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Nonmagical attacks
traits.text: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons A fight has no way to ask whether a weapon is magical, so this qualifier is not applied.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 30 ft., fly 60 ft.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While the gargoyle remains motion less, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

entries.label: Gelatinous Cube
entries.summary: Large ooze, unaligned. Armor Class 6, 84 hit points, challenge rating 2.

traits.name: Engulf
traits.text: The cube moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the cube enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the cube. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Gelatinous Cube is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Ooze Cube
traits.text: The cube takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube's Engulf and has disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the cube can be seen but have total cover. A creature within 5 feet of the cube can take an action to pull a creature or object out of the cube. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Transparent
traits.text: Even when the cube is in plain sight, it takes a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a cube that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the cube's space while unaware of the cube is surprised by the cube.

entries.label: Ghast
entries.summary: Medium undead, chaotic evil. Armor Class 13, 36 hit points, challenge rating 2.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Ghast is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Stench
traits.text: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the ghast must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the ghast's Stench for 24 hours.

traits.name: Turn Defiance
traits.text: The ghast and any ghouls within 30 ft. of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

entries.label: Ghost
entries.summary: Medium undead, any alignment. Armor Class 11, 45 hit points, challenge rating 4.

traits.name: Etherealness
traits.text: The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Ghost is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Nonmagical attacks
traits.text: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks A fight has no way to ask whether a weapon is magical, so this qualifier is not applied.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 0 ft., fly 40 ft. (hover)

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.text: The ghost can see 60 ft. into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

entries.label: Ghoul
entries.summary: Medium undead, chaotic evil. Armor Class 12, 22 hit points, challenge rating 1.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Ghoul is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Divine Eminence
traits.text: As a bonus action, the priest can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If the priest expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: The priest is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). See the SRD for the full text.

entries.label: Pseudodragon
entries.summary: Tiny dragon, neutral good. Armor Class 13, 7 hit points, challenge rating 1/4.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 15 ft., fly 60 ft.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: The pseudodragon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.text: The pseudodragon can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature within 100 ft. of it that can understand a language.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The pseudodragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Variant: Familiar
traits.text: The pseudodragon can serve another creature as a familiar, forming a magic, telepathic bond with that willing companion. While the two are bonded, the companion can sense what the pseudodragon senses as long as they are within 1 mile of each other. See the SRD for the full text.

entries.label: Purple Worm
entries.summary: Gargantuan monstrosity, unaligned. Armor Class 18, 247 hit points, challenge rating 15.

traits.name: Bite
traits.text: Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Tail Stinger
traits.text: Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 50 ft., burrow 30 ft.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.text: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

entries.label: Quasit
entries.summary: Tiny fiend, chaotic evil. Armor Class 13, 7 hit points, challenge rating 1.

traits.name: Claw
traits.text: Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) poison damage and become poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.text: The quasit magically turns invisible until it attacks or uses Scare, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the quasit wears or carries is invisible with it.

traits.name: Nonmagical attacks
traits.text: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks A fight has no way to ask whether a weapon is magical, so this qualifier is not applied.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The quasit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.text: The quasit can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a bat (speed 10 ft. fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., swim 40 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Variant: Familiar
traits.text: The quasit can serve another creature as a familiar, forming a telepathic bond with its willing master. While the two are bonded, the master can sense what the quasit senses as long as they are within 1 mile of each other. While the quasit is within 10 feet of its master, the master shares the quasit's Magic Resistance trait. See the SRD for the full text.

entries.label: Quipper
entries.summary: Tiny beast, unaligned. Armor Class 13, 1 hit points, challenge rating 0.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 0 ft., swim 40 ft.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: The quipper has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Water Breathing

entries.label: Rakshasa
entries.summary: Medium fiend, lawful evil. Armor Class 16, 110 hit points, challenge rating 13.

traits.name: Nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The rakshasa's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). The rakshasa can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect thoughts, disguise self, mage hand, minor illusion 3/day each: charm person, detect magic, invisibility, major image, suggestion 1/day each: dominate person, fly, plane shift, true seeing

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.text: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Speed

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.text: The raven can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

entries.summary: Medium dragon, chaotic evil. Armor Class 17, 75 hit points, challenge rating 4.

traits.name: Speed

traits.name: Speed

traits.text: The shark has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the shark's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.text: The shark can breathe only underwater.

traits.name: Speed

traits.name: Heated Body

entries.label: Rhinoceros
entries.summary: Large beast, unaligned. Armor Class 11, 45 hit points, challenge rating 2.

traits.name: Charge
traits.text: If the rhinoceros moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

entries.label: Riding Horse
entries.summary: Large beast, unaligned. Armor Class 10, 13 hit points, challenge rating 1/4.

entries.label: Roc
entries.summary: Gargantuan monstrosity, unaligned. Armor Class 15, 248 hit points, challenge rating 11.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 20 ft., fly 120 ft.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.text: The roc has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.label: Roper
entries.summary: Large monstrosity, neutral evil. Armor Class 20, 93 hit points, challenge rating 5.

traits.name: Tendril
traits.text: Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and the roper can't use the same tendril on another target.

traits.name: Reel
traits.text: The roper pulls each creature grappled by it up to 25 ft. straight toward it.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.text: The roper makes four attacks with its tendrils, uses Reel, and makes one attack with its bite.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 10 ft., climb 10 ft.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While the roper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation, such as a stalagmite.

traits.name: Grasping Tendrils
traits.text: The roper can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the roper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn. A tendril can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a DC 15 Strength check against it.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.label: Rug of Smothering
entries.summary: Large construct, unaligned. Armor Class 12, 33 hit points, challenge rating 2.

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.text: The rug is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the rug must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.text: While it is grappling a creature, the rug takes only half the damage dealt to it, and the creature grappled by the rug takes the other half.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While the rug remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal rug.

entries.label: Rust Monster
entries.summary: Medium monstrosity, unaligned. Armor Class 14, 27 hit points, challenge rating 1/2.

traits.name: Antennae
traits.text: The rust monster corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object it can see within 5 feet of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw to avoid the rust monster's touch. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Iron Scent
traits.text: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.

traits.name: Rust Metal
traits.text: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the rust monster corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Non magical ammunition made of metal that hits the rust monster is destroyed after dealing damage.

entries.label: Saber-Toothed Tiger
entries.summary: Large beast, unaligned. Armor Class 12, 52 hit points, challenge rating 2.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.text: The tiger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.text: If the tiger moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the tiger can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

entries.label: Sahuagin
entries.summary: Medium humanoid, lawful evil. Armor Class 12, 22 hit points, challenge rating 1/2.

traits.name: Spear
traits.text: Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.text: The sahuagin makes two melee attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or spear.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 30 ft., swim 40 ft.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: The sahuagin has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.text: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

traits.name: Shark Telepathy
traits.text: The sahuagin can magically command any shark within 120 feet of it, using a limited telepathy.

entries.label: Salamander
entries.summary: Large elemental, neutral evil. Armor Class 15, 90 hit points, challenge rating 5.

traits.name: Spear
traits.text: Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Nonmagical attacks
traits.text: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks A fight has no way to ask whether a weapon is magical, so this qualifier is not applied.

traits.name: Heated Body
traits.text: A creature that touches the salamander or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Heated Weapons
traits.text: Any metal melee weapon the salamander wields deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage on a hit (included in the attack).

entries.label: Satyr
entries.summary: Medium fey, chaotic neutral. Armor Class 14, 31 hit points, challenge rating 1/2.

traits.name: Variant: Panpipes
traits.text: Gentle Lullaby. The creature falls asleep and is unconscious for 1 minute. The effect ends if the creature takes damage or if someone takes an action to shake the creature awake.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The satyr has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.label: Scorpion
entries.summary: Tiny beast, unaligned. Armor Class 11, 1 hit points, challenge rating 0.

traits.name: Sting
traits.text: Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 9 Constitution saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.label: Scout
entries.summary: Medium humanoid, any alignment. Armor Class 13, 16 hit points, challenge rating 1/2.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.text: The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.text: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

entries.label: Sea Hag
entries.summary: Medium fey, chaotic evil. Armor Class 14, 52 hit points, challenge rating 2.

traits.name: Death Glare
traits.text: The hag targets one frightened creature she can see within 30 ft. of her. If the target can see the hag, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or drop to 0 hit points.

traits.name: Illusory Appearance
traits.text: The hag covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like an ugly creature of her general size and humanoid shape. The effect ends if the hag takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies. The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 30 ft., swim 40 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Hag Coven
traits.text: When hags must work together, they form covens, in spite of their selfish natures. A coven is made up of hags of any type, all of whom are equals within the group. However, each of the hags continues to desire more personal power. A coven consists of three hags so that any arguments between two hags can be settled by the third. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Hag Eye (Coven Only)
traits.text: A hag coven can craft a magic item called a hag eye, which is made from a real eye coated in varnish and often fitted to a pendant or other wearable item. The hag eye is usually entrusted to a minion for safekeeping and transport. A hag in the coven can take an action to see what the hag eye sees if the hag eye is on the same plane of existence. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Horrific Appearance
traits.text: Any humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag's true form must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the hag is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Shared Spellcasting (Coven Only)
traits.text: While all three members of a hag coven are within 30 feet of one another, they can each cast the following spells from the wizard's spell list but must share the spell slots among themselves: * 1st level (4 slots): identify, ray of sickness * 2nd level (3 slots): hold person, locate object * 3rd level (3 slots): bestow curse, counterspell, lightning bolt * 4th level See the SRD for the full text.

entries.label: Shadow
entries.summary: Medium undead, chaotic evil. Armor Class 12, 16 hit points, challenge rating 1/2.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Shadow is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Nonmagical attacks
traits.text: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks A fight has no way to ask whether a weapon is magical, so this qualifier is not applied.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.text: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.text: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.text: While in sunlight, the shadow has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

entries.label: Shambling Mound
entries.summary: Large plant, unaligned. Armor Class 15, 136 hit points, challenge rating 5.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.text: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 14), and the shambling mound uses its Engulf on it.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Shambling Mound is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 20 ft., swim 20 ft.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.text: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

entries.label: Shield Guardian
entries.summary: Large construct, unaligned. Armor Class 17, 142 hit points, challenge rating 7.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Shield Guardian is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Bound
traits.text: The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: The shield guardian regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit. point.

traits.name: Spell Storing
traits.text: A spellcaster who wears the shield guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of 4th level or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Shield
traits.text: When a creature makes an attack against the wearer of the guardian's amulet, the guardian grants a +2 bonus to the wearer's AC if the guardian is within 5 feet of the wearer.

entries.label: Silver Dragon Wyrmling
entries.summary: Medium dragon, lawful good. Armor Class 17, 45 hit points, challenge rating 2.

traits.name: Breath Weapons
traits.text: Paralyzing Breath. The dragon exhales paralyzing gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 30 ft., fly 60 ft.

traits.name: Slaying Longbow
traits.text: Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage. If the target is a creature that has 190 hit points or fewer, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or die.

traits.name: Flying Sword
traits.text: The solar releases its greatsword to hover magically in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of it. If the solar can see the sword, the solar can mentally command it as a bonus action to fly up to 50 ft. and either make one attack against a target or return to the solar's hands. If the hovering sword is targeted by any effect, the solar is considered to be holding it. See the SRD for the full text.

traits.name: Healing Touch
traits.text: The solar touches another creature. The target magically regains 40 (8d8 + 4) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

traits.name: Teleport
traits.text: The solar magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Solar is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Nonmagical attacks
traits.text: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks A fight has no way to ask whether a weapon is magical, so this qualifier is not applied.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 50 ft., fly 150 ft.

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.text: The solar's weapon attacks are magical. When the solar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 6d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

entries.label: Specter
entries.summary: Medium undead, chaotic evil. Armor Class 12, 22 hit points, challenge rating 1.

traits.name: Life Drain
traits.text: Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

traits.name: Immune to exhaustion
traits.text: The Specter is immune to exhaustion, which this sheet counts on a track rather than as a condition.

traits.name: Nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 0 ft., fly 50 ft. (hover)

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the specter has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.label: Spider
entries.summary: Tiny beast, unaligned. Armor Class 12, 1 hit points, challenge rating 0.

traits.name: Bite
traits.text: Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw or take 2 (1d4) poison damage.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 20 ft., climb 20 ft.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.text: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.text: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

spells.notes: Necromancy. Casting time: action. Range: 30 feet. Duration: instantaneous. Components: V, S.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.text: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points. Only a wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

entries.label: Sprite
entries.summary: Tiny fey, neutral good. Armor Class 15, 2 hit points, challenge rating 1/4.

traits.name: Heart Sight
traits.text: The sprite touches a creature and magically knows the creature's current emotional state. If the target fails a DC 10 Charisma saving throw, the sprite also knows the creature's alignment. Celestials, fiends, and undead automatically fail the saving throw.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.text: The sprite magically turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the sprite wears or carries is invisible with it.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: 10 ft., fly 40 ft.

entries.label: Spy
entries.summary: Medium humanoid, any alignment. Armor Class 12, 27 hit points, challenge rating 1.

traits.name: Cunning Action
